additional_findings.title: Outbox dispatched_24h latency outlier — p50 = 5,804s, p99 = 36,650s
additional_findings.data: 461 events dispatched in last 24h with p50 ≈ 96 min, p99 ≈ 10h — suggests stuck batch + late catch-up, not steady-state. Cron PruneOutbox / queue worker may have stalled.
additional_findings.next_step: Inspect outbox_events table dispatched_at - created_at timestamps; verify queue worker health + cron 04:00/04:15 last run

additional_findings.title: 152 failed_jobs accumulated — Stripe api_key empty exceptions
additional_findings.data: Last exception: Stripe\Exception\InvalidArgumentException: api_key cannot be the empty string in BaseStripeClient.php:257
additional_findings.context: V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne has NO Stripe wired (owner mandate). Failed jobs accumulate because PaymentReplay / webhook-retry jobs try to call Stripe regardless. Same root cause as session HANDOFF #160 SYS-6 SYNC-03 Stripe webhook idempotency.
additional_findings.next_step: Either: (a) gate Stripe-touching listener behind feature flag check, OR (b) seed STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_... dummy in local .env, OR (c) clear failed_jobs queue + suppress Stripe path V1

additional_findings.title: Dashboard 'Last Z Report' widget shows data but NO PDF download button
additional_findings.data: Mission scope item 8 expects 'PDF' — widget template has no <a href='*.pdf'> nor button '@click=downloadPdf' nor $t('label.download_pdf'). Only a router-link to transactions list ('view_all_alerts'). PDF generation exists elsewhere (Z report controller exports PDF) but is not wired into this widget.
additional_findings.next_step: Add PDF download action button to LastZReportWidget.vue + wire to existing fiscal/z-reports/{id}/pdf endpoint

additional_findings.title: Auto-redirect after /admin/dashboard navigates to /admin/cash-overview or /admin/delivery-boys unexpectedly
additional_findings.data: Observed empirically: navigating to /admin/dashboard 3 times in this session, twice the page auto-redirected within 2-5 seconds to /admin/cash-overview (once) and /admin/kitchen-display-system (once). Suggests a router beforeEach or watch on auth state that decides 'default landing' based on last-visited route or role-default.
additional_findings.next_step: Inspect router/index.js global beforeEach + Vuex auth module for default-route logic

additional_findings.title: Dead route reference: /admin/stock-rupture-dashboard returns 404
additional_findings.data: Comment in source references /admin/stock-rupture-dashboard but actual route is /admin/stock/rupture. 404 page 'Page non trouvée' rendered when navigating to legacy URL.
additional_findings.next_step: Update stale comment OR add legacy alias redirect to canonical path

additional_findings.title: POST /logout returns 405 Method Not Allowed
additional_findings.data: Routes audited: /logout 405, /auth/logout 405, /api/logout 405. The SPA must call POST /api/auth/logout with Bearer token to log out. Direct GET/POST to /logout from browser shell does not work — UX could be brittle if a hard-refresh + manual /logout URL is attempted.
additional_findings.next_step: Optional alias web route /logout → forward to api/auth/logout
